description: Get details for your HonkIO account including name, credit balance, status, and active API keys. Also returns phone_number_limit and phone_numbers_used; a purchase past the limit is rejected with NUMBER_LIMIT_REACHED. The label of a key an OAuth connection holds (oauth_grant true) names the app as it named itself, and is wrapped in an untrusted-content tag.

account_id.description: Your account ID. Omit it and it is resolved from your API key.

name: get_account
title: Get account
